registrationRequirements: Exactly four source frames mapped to original board columns 0,1,2,3. Record per-frame semantic name and original source bounds.

One shared authored canvas, scale and origin across the four phases; stable measured effect origin. No independent bbox normalization, recentering, blanket resizing or translated/scaled copies presented as authored phases.
Keep phase-specific growth, shrinkage, trajectory and material changes. Unique hashes are necessary diagnostics, not proof of meaningful motion.
Source SHA-256 and decoded-pixel SHA-256 per frame; lock shared transform, frame order, pivot and output hashes in a reproducible review bundle.
Keep 1x and 2x as deterministic exports of the same full authored canvases, with both manifest records/density and actual renderer URL checked.
alphaRequirements: PNG RGBA; transparent exterior with no unrelated opaque backing. Preserve intended interior partial alpha, smoky decay, glow and light.
Do not force alpha maximum >=240 for each phase; do not opacity-normalize fading phases. Do not weaken unit/prop gates globally.
Default output perimeter clear; any deliberate boundary contact must be explicitly reviewed. Source/current clipped beams in FX-16 are not a good template.
Meaningful visible content in each currently specified phase. A completely empty terminal phase would be a separately reviewed semantic change.
Inspect black, white, bright stone, green terrain and dark earth composites. A clear outer border does not prove absence of an opaque internal rectangle or cloudy backdrop.
No chroma keyed background, white fringe, saturated-magenta remnant or baked scene tile in new masters. Physical source motifs (stones, coals, tower, plinth) must be deliberate and compact.
motionAndConsumerChecks: Play exact source order 0,1,2,3 at 12 fps; verify non-loop hold through hit 420ms and heal 500ms deletion.
FX-09..12 only are loop=true; review 3→0 continuity but do not invent weather/environment consumers.

Make FX anchor the single owner by correcting all 24 records to [16,16] and consuming it directly; this preserves current [-16,-16] draw positions. Characterize all current outputs and test non-centered anchor consumption. Do not apply old [16,24] or retain competing center fallback.
Normal source-over remains the blend. A screen/additive requirement needs an explicit rendering contract change in both backends.
For FX-01 pilot compare with the BoardView hit burst/number enabled; otherwise screenshots do not show the real overlay.
Review at true 32 logical pixels and HD density, then in the existing first-level hit event path. Staged comparison is not proof of live playback.

firstPilot.pivotDecision: First unify the single pivot owner in a behavior-preserving engineering change: correct the 24 manifest anchors to actual [16,16] and make the renderer consume anchor. Keep all existing output positions [-16,-16]. Regress every topic and a non-centered test anchor; the FX-01 pilot then targets the declared [16,16] anchor without any competing fallback.
firstPilot.renderReview: At actual scene size evaluate all 4 frames and 0..420ms sequence over bright stone, dark earth and green ground, with normal hit circle/number present. Check that growth is visible and final fragments are unobtrusive during held-final-frame interval.
firstPilot.nextOptional: FX-17 heal exercises legitimate glow/translucent phase export after the slash pilot is accepted; do not include it in the first pilot by default.
